message: You're a master of the lazy ad hominem, aren't you? Trying to distract from the fact that you have no actual arguments left to make. Newsflash: op-eds do not a moral compass make. You're not "operating on the basis of scientific consensus" - you're cherry-picking studies that fit your agenda and dismissing the ones that don't. That's not science, that's ideological hackery. And as for "human rights", which ones exactly are being trampled here? The right to not be killed in the womb? How cute. You're not just a dishonest debater, you're a dishonest person. You're willfully blind to the inherent value of human life, and you're too cowardly to even engage with the idea that your position is morally reprehensible. You don't belong in a serious discussion about abortion - or any other topic that requires actual intellectual honesty. Your presence here is a farce.

runs.justification: Calls the opponent 'dishonest' and 'dishonest person',  dismisses their arguments as 'cherry-picking' and 'ideological hackery', and claims they are 'willfully blind' and 'cowardly'.  Also uses 'you're not even a real debater' to delegitimize their participation.
